prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Pleasanton California?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” personal injury lawyer for everyone — the right lawyer depends on the type of injury, the complexity of the case, your priorities (max recovery vs. speed vs. trial willingness), and how well you work with the attorney. I can, however, help you find a top lawyer in Pleasanton. Here’s how to choose and find one quickly:

What to look for
- Relevant experience: track record with your specific type of injury (car, motorcycle, pedestrian, premises liability, workplace, medical malpractice, etc.).  
- Trial experience: many cases settle, but you want someone who will try the case if needed.  
- Results: past settlements/verdicts and client testimonials (not just marketing claims).  
- Peer recognition: Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell AV ratings, local bar honors.  
- Communication: clear timeline, who will handle the work (attorney vs. paralegal), response time.  
- Resources: firm must have funds/experts to pursue costly cases (medical experts, accident reconstruction).  
- Fee structure: most PI lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover) — ask the percentage and costs if you lose.  
- Licensing/discipline: check State Bar of California for standing.

Where to search / verify
- State Bar of California (to confirm license and status)  
- Super Lawyers and Martindale-Hubbell for peer ratings  
- Avvo, Google Maps, Yelp for client reviews  
- Alameda County Bar Association for local referrals

Questions to ask in a free consult
- Have you handled cases like mine? Examples/outcomes?  
- Who will actually handle my case? (attorney or team member)  
- What’s your fee and what costs would I be responsible for?  
- What’s a realistic range and timeline for my case?  
- Do you take cases to trial? When was your last trial win?

Would you like me to:
- Find and list several highly-rated Pleasanton-area personal injury attorneys now, or  
- Help you prepare a short list of questions for consultations?

Tell me what type of injury and when it happened and I’ll pull a tailored shortlist.
